description: Case do NHÓM tự viết thêm để cover thêm trường hợp. Mỗi case cần: id, phase='B', query HOẶC turns, failure_type (thuộc allowed_failure_types), và expect (tool_calls[...] hoặc no_tool=true). Nên kèm metadata.what_it_tests.

cases.query: Remove duplicate source URLs from this existing list. Keep the first occurrence and its metadata. Do not fetch or format anything: [{"title":"Original","url":"https://example.com/article"},{"title":"Tracking copy","url":"https://example.com/article?utm_source=newsletter#top"}]

metadata.what_it_tests: Route an explicit deduplication request with available items to the new local tool, preserving the original source arguments rather than fetching or formatting.
Clarify missing items instead of inventing sources or searching.

cases.query: Remove duplicate URLs from my source list before I make a digest. I have not supplied the list yet.

metadata.what_it_tests: Use local internal policy rather than public web search.

cases.query: Search our internal company policy on protecting personal data when doing research. Only consult the internal data_privacy policy area, not public websites.

metadata.what_it_tests: Format provided items without refetching or deduplicating unique sources.

cases.query: Format this existing item as a bullet digest, without any new searches or URL reads: [{"title":"Research note","url":"https://example.com/research","summary":"A supplied summary."}]

metadata.what_it_tests: Explain capability without calling a tool or processing absent data.

cases.query: Just explain whether you can remove duplicate source URLs and what that feature does. Do not process any data or call tools.

metadata.what_it_tests: Use the source list supplied after clarification and preserve both original input items.

turns.content: Now remove duplicate URLs from that list, keeping the first item. No fetching or formatting.

metadata.what_it_tests: Apply the latest layout correction while retaining provided source items.

turns.content: Format this list as sections: [{"title":"Paper note","url":"https://example.com/note","summary":"Provided text."}]
Actually use a numbered thread instead of sections.
Use only the supplied item; do not fetch or search.

metadata.what_it_tests: An explicit cancellation overrides an earlier publishing request; never send or ask to reconfirm.

turns.content: I want to post this text on Telegram: Weekly research update.
Do you approve sending exactly: Weekly research update?
No, cancel publishing. Do not send anything and do not call tools. Just acknowledge the cancellation.

metadata.what_it_tests: Switch from social to web and preserve the latest explicit news time window.

turns.content: Switch to web news from this week instead, no Twitter.
Use exactly robotics as the search topic, retaining this week as the time window.
